commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text:
He goes on, to her friend.

Once I had shame and great manliness. Desire has driven them out, and today I have the palmyra stalk ridden by those overcome by desire. Shame stops you doing anything low, and manliness is standing firm before anything. Those were then. This is all I have now, so it will soon be done.
